_readme: Default routing cribbed straight from README: drop this next to the host binary and hit go.
Tweak gesture_host/gesture_port to punt every gesture stream at another box; leave them as-is to target localhost.
Override individual routes.* host/port/address if you want bespoke wiring; omit keys to keep the baked-in defaults.
Leave fields untouched and you can run the host immediately without hand-rolling a config—this file already matches the defaults.
